INSERT INTO site_settings (`key`, `value`, `description`) VALUES
  ('lift_threshold_1_depth_in', '10', 'Beam depth (inches) at or above which 1 material lift is suggested (e.g. 10 = any 2x10+ or LVL 10"+)'),
  ('lift_threshold_2_depth_in', '14', 'Beam depth (inches) at or above which a 2nd material lift is suggested'),
  ('lift_cost_1', '450', 'Price charged for 1 material lift'),
  ('lift_cost_2', '800', 'Price charged for 2 material lifts (replaces lift_cost_1, not additive)')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  value = VALUES(value),
  description = VALUES(description);
